custom-error.description:
An error of the application's own, such as a server-side verdict on the
submitted selection ("Pick regions we deliver to"). While it holds text
the group is invalid, blocks its form, shows the text in place of the
help text at once and is announced as invalid. It stops counting when the
person toggles an option, or when the form is reset, so it never blocks
the corrected answer. It outranks `error-text` and an error set with
`setCustomValidity`.
When to use: report a verdict from a declarative spec, a live update or a
framework binding. Remove it when a new attempt starts.
When NOT to use: do not use it for the `min` and `max` limits the group
enforces itself; `error-text` words those. Setting the same text again
while the prop still holds it shows nothing: remove it first, then set it
again.

disabled.description: Makes the group unavailable and excludes it from form submission.

error-text.description: Localized message displayed for a failing selection limit.

help-text.description: One line of guidance displayed under the choices.

label.description: Visible legend and accessible name for these choices.

max.description: Maximum number of checked options, as a nonnegative integer.

min.description: Minimum number of checked options, as a nonnegative integer.

name.description: Form-data key repeated for each selected option.

orientation.description: Lays choices out vertically or in a wrapping horizontal row.

--ki-checkbox-group-gap.description: Space between checkbox options and the group label and messages.

--ki-radio-group-label-font-size.description: dimension used by the radio group component for label font size.

--ki-radio-group-label-font-weight.description: font weight used by the radio group component for label font weight.

--ki-radio-group-label-line-height.description: dimension used by the radio group component for label line height (closest measured analogue: Radio_label sm 13/20; no group-title master exists — low-confidence refinement).

--ki-text-danger-high-em.description: semantic color for text danger high em.

--ki-text-high-em.description: semantic color for text high em.

--ki-text-med-em.description: semantic color for text med em.

--ki-text-supporting.description: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-normal.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

component.description: A form-associated group of independently selectable checkboxes.

ki-change.description: Fires once for a committed user toggle with a copy of the current selection.

error.description: Polite error message shown in place of the help.

help.description: Guidance below the options and the group's accessible description.

value.description:
Selected values in option order. Assign a fresh array to update selection
silently. Initial checked options seed the group when this property is
omitted. In HTML and catalog specs use `checked` on each selected option.

slots.description:
Direct `ki-checkbox` options, each with its own visible label and value.
Put form naming and constraints on the group.
